# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Agatha is a stout, heavy-set woman who walks with a perpetual waddle. She sits by her kitchen window watching the road and knitting cotton warp quilts. She is energetic and physically robust until later years, when she suffers a fall down the cellar stairs.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c29 P30](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0030), [v2 c27 P8](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0008)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is an outspoken, proficient homemaker and community leader who pays strict attention to her neighbors' affairs. She takes pride in expressing her mind freely and is known as a vigilant, perceptive woman. Though often critical and sharp-tongued, she possesses a deeply kind heart and a willingness to help those in need.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby resides in Sowerby's Hollow, keeping a close eye on all travelers passing through Brierley. When Obed and Thirza Abernethy take in the orphan Nell Harcourt, Agatha initially disapproves and warns them of danger. During a visit, she offends Nell by commenting bluntly on her red hair and freckles, sparking a fiery outburst from the girl. After Nell apologizes, Agatha forgives her and grows fond of her over time. Years later, following the death of her husband Thomas, Agatha sells her farm and moves into Grey Shutters to live with Thirza Abernethy, assisting her with household duties and community projects.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P22](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0022)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley with her husband Thomas.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- Raised ten children and buried two.  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Directed the Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary.  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Quotes

> Following tea, I will simply pop over to Grey Shutters and ascertain from Thirza his destination and reasoning.  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>

> Well, Thirza, I’m simply going to state plainly that I believe you are doing an extremely silly thing—a hazardous thing, that is what.  <sub>[v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)</sub>

> She’s awfully thin and plain, Thirza. Step over this way, child, so I can inspect you. Goodness gracious, has anyone ever witnessed such freckles? And hair that is as red as carrots!  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>

> Come, come, stand up, little one. Naturally, you have my forgiveness. It seems I was likely somewhat overly strict with you, regardless.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>
